use.en: Local pressure over a small area

caution.zh-CN: 避开急性损伤、骨突与神经血管区
caution.en: Avoid acute injuries, bony points and neurovascular areas

evidenceScope.zh-CN: 恢复文献只支持相应干预，不可把泡沫轴证据迁移成筋膜枪、按摩球或其他设备的有效性证明。
evidenceScope.en: Recovery evidence applies to the studied interventions. Foam-rolling evidence does not validate percussion guns or other devices.
